picks.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan sign defence pact
picks.summary: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan signed a mutual-defence pact in Mecca stating an attack on any one of the three will be treated as an attack on all, a move announced amid escalating regional turmoil including Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia and rising US-Iran tension over the Strait of Hormuz.
flags: Timing reads as a direct response to the US-Israel-Iran standoff, not just a routine alliance

picks.title: Besieged Sudanese city faces relentless drone strikes and risk of mass atrocities, U.N. warns
picks.summary: The UN warns that hundreds of thousands of civilians in el-Obeid, Sudan are being battered by relentless drone strikes, facing critical water shortages and a worsening cholera outbreak, with women and girls reporting high rates of sexual violence as the war grinds on largely out of Western headlines.
flags: UN language ('risk of mass atrocities') is a strong, deliberate escalation in tone

picks.bucket: US as the world sees it
picks.title: Trump again tries to limit US birthright citizenship with new executive orders
picks.summary: President Trump signed new executive orders banning 'birth tourism' and expanding the definition of children ineligible for US birthright citizenship, the latest in a series of attempts to reshape the policy that international outlets are following closely as a test of executive power versus the 14th Amendment.
flags: Legality is contested — prior similar orders have been blocked in court

picks.title: Foreign Ministry weekly press briefing: Somalia to West Asia, MEA lays out India's policy
picks.summary: India's Ministry of External Affairs used its weekly briefing to outline its diplomatic posture across a wide arc from Somalia to West Asia, part of state broadcaster DD News's routine coverage of government foreign-policy positioning this week (no transcript/summary was provided upstream, so this is a title-level gist).
flags: Source item had no body text — headline-only gist
picks.origTitle: सोमालिया से पश्चिम एशिया तक, MEA ने रखी भारत की नीति

picks.title: Bangladesh's former foreign minister under Yunus makes claims about India
picks.summary: Touhid Hussain, who served as Bangladesh's foreign affairs adviser under Muhammad Yunus's interim government, said Yunus viewed India as a 'geopolitical reality' and had sought time with PM Modi to work out a way to engage with New Delhi, offering a rare inside account of Dhaka-Delhi relations during the transition government.
picks.origTitle: मोहम्मद यूनुस की सरकार में बांग्लादेश के 'विदेश मंत्री' रहे तौहीद हुसैन ने भारत को लेकर किए कई दावे

picks.title: Lawyer assesses prospects of a lawsuit to remove Yabloko from Duma elections
picks.summary: State-run RIA Novosti covered a legal expert's assessment of the odds that a lawsuit seeking to strike the liberal Yabloko party from the State Duma election list will succeed, part of a wider push this week by the nationalist Rodina party to have Yabloko disqualified.
flags: State-media source — treat framing with caution; effort to remove an opposition party from ballots
picks.origTitle: Юрист оценил перспективу иска о снятии списка "Яблока" с выборов в ГД

picks.title: FSB raids crypto exchangers in Moscow City, detains over 20 — some thought they worked for the FSB
picks.summary: Independent outlet Meduza reports the FSB raided crypto exchange operations in the Moscow City business complex and detained more than 20 people, alleging the exchangers illegally moved Russians' money to Ukraine via scam call centers — with the twist that some detainees believed they were themselves working for the FSB.
flags: Bizarre entrapment angle — detainees reportedly believed they were FSB assets
picks.origTitle: ФСБ устроила облаву на криптообменники в «Москва-Сити» — через них якобы выводили деньги россиян в Украину. Задержаны больше 20 человек. Некоторые из них считали, что работают на ФСБ

picks.title: Seoul temperature tops 40°C as South Korea suffers worst heatwave in its history
picks.summary: Chinese state media reports Seoul's temperature has broken 40°C for the first time as South Korea endures its most severe heatwave on record, following earlier record highs in Gyeonggi, Gyeongsan and Gwangyang.
picks.origTitle: 首尔气温突破40摄氏度，韩国遭遇史上最严重热浪

picks.title: Kumamoto earthquake: 38 dead including suspected disaster-related deaths, 6,651 in shelters
picks.summary: Public broadcaster NHK reports the death toll from the Kumamoto earthquake has reached 38, including suspected disaster-related deaths, with 6,651 people still in evacuation shelters as of the afternoon of August 7 — an ongoing disaster compounded by a heatwave and an approaching typhoon.
picks.origTitle: 熊本地震 災害関連死の疑い含め38人死亡 避難所に6651人避難

picks.title: Kyoto University Hospital medical accident: wrong site removed in brain tumor surgery, patient left unable to breathe on own
picks.summary: Asahi Shimbun reports Kyoto University Hospital removed healthy brain tissue instead of the intended tumor during surgery, leaving the patient unable to breathe spontaneously — a serious medical-error case now under scrutiny.
picks.origTitle: 京大病院で医療事故　脳腫瘍の手術で正常部位摘出、自発呼吸不能に

picks.title: A walk through downtown Burlington shows a city in crisis
picks.summary: An opinion piece describes a walk from St. Paul Street to Church Street in downtown Burlington turning up open drug use on nearly every block despite a new state police presence — published alongside a companion VTDigger opinion piece arguing that blaming addicts for the city's problems misses the point.
flags: Opinion piece with a direct rebuttal opinion running the same day — contested framing of Burlington's addiction crisis

picks.title: Daily reservoir monitor: 13 reservoirs drop, five see slight rise, as rationing begins
picks.summary: El Nuevo Día's daily reservoir tracker shows 13 of Puerto Rico's reservoirs losing water and only five gaining slightly, on the same day official water rationing begins in several municipalities served by the Carraízo reservoir.
picks.origTitle: Monitoreo diario: 13 embalses reducen sus niveles de agua y cinco registran un leve aumento

picks.title: Anthropic will design its own hardware to power Claude
picks.summary: Anthropic confirmed plans to build an in-house silicon team to design custom hardware for running Claude, joining OpenAI in a race to scale AI compute while reducing dependence on Nvidia.

picks.title: AMD acquires Taalas to boost inference performance by etching models into silicon
picks.summary: AMD acquired AI chip startup Taalas, which etches trained models directly into silicon to speed up inference, part of the broader wave of chipmakers racing to specialize hardware for AI workloads.

picks.title: Jony Ive's first OpenAI gadget is reportedly a hockey-puck-sized smart speaker
picks.summary: Bloomberg reports the AI device OpenAI is developing with former Apple designer Jony Ive is a battery-powered, display-less smart speaker roughly the size of a hockey puck, expected to launch in 2027 for over $300.

picks.title: Large genome models used to design new viruses
picks.summary: Researchers used a large genome AI model to design genetically distant new versions of a bacteria-killing virus, demonstrating generative models can now create novel viral genomes rather than just analyze existing ones.
flags: Dual-use biosecurity concern — AI-designed viral genomes raise obvious safety questions even for benign (bacteriophage) targets

picks.title: Giant Ojō-sama TV Anime Reveals Visual, Staff, January 2027 Premiere
picks.summary: An anime adaptation of Nikumura Q's manga 'Giant Ojō-sama' has revealed its key visual and staff, with Hiroshi Ikehata directing at Tatsunoko Production ahead of a January 2027 premiere.

picks.title: We Might Be Drunk Ep 273: Adam Carolla
picks.source: Mark Normand - We Might Be Drunk
picks.summary: Adam Carolla joins Mark Normand and Sam Morril for a wide-ranging episode covering vintage Porsches, old Seinfeld snubs, and boutique-hotel horror stories.

picks.title: Matt Taibbi, America's Top Gonzo Journalist, on How the Media Lost Its Mind
picks.summary: Rolling Stone reporter Matt Taibbi joins Josh Szeps to discuss what happened to American news media, why diversity-driven staffing debates coincided with a decline in objective journalism, and why he remains optimistic about what comes next.

picks.title: WTF? Gladiator Battles on the White House Lawn: How MMA & the Manosphere Took Over America
picks.summary: TIME's Sean Gregory joins Josh Szeps to explain how UFC boss Dana White turned MMA from a banned pay-per-view novelty into a mainstream force now literally staged on the White House lawn, and what that says about masculinity and MAGA politics.
